objective_ko: 지금까지 수집한 모든 BCT 자료를 활용해 어떤 경제적 수혜 경로든 검토하고, 현재 가격·자금·희석을 고려해 12개월 내 주가 2~3배를 설명할 근거가 있는 미국 정규거래소 상장주를 선별한다. 수익 보장이나 검증된 상승확률을 주장하지 않는다.
source_write_policy: READ_ONLY; never write BCT main, data, future-bottleneck-data or operating branches
source_snapshot_scope: All visible remote branch tips except bct-stocks; history within retained files included; deleted Git history and unfetched external originals not claimed
visibility_notice: Temporary independent branch in the existing PUBLIC repository, not a newly created repository. No portfolio holdings, credentials or private trading information may be committed.
approval: User PASS between stages; importing does not approve investment decisions
estimates: Allowed with explicit evidence, bounds and assumptions; unknown is not zero
risk: Loss-making/pre-production allowed; funding-before-catalyst, dilution and illiquidity separate gates
accounting: Verify each issuer basis; US GAAP ASC606 or issuer-applicable IFRS, not exchange-based assumption
pricing: Fetch fresh common-date price and dated shares; inherited BCT prices/ranks are never current inputs
a_class: Base-case 2x must be audited; never automatically outranks robust bull-case 2-3x; audit shared optimism if several A cases

freeze.end: anniversary close or prior trading-day close
freeze.versioning: append only; original clock, universe and decisions never reset
